payload.summary: Measured 2026-09-26: answer time is dominated by search (database lookups plus re-ranking), not generation, and generation recorded 0.0 s
payload.detail: This is the measurement #GCB0DV asked for, and it lands outside both branches of that row's decision tree (neither generation, i.e. #231/#100, nor page delivery, i.e. #016). One run of scripts/probe-answer-timing.mjs from the owner's PC in Perth (owner-approved, #GCB0DV), query 'What FBC threshold should stop clozapine?', HTTP 200: client total 13.4 s, server total 11.9 s, network/queue 1.5 s. search 9.2 s (77%) = rpc 4.2 s + rerank 4.1 s + embedding <0.1 s; ratelimit 1.4 s; auth and scope <0.1 s each; generation 0.0 s. So #231/#100 (generation) are NOT the first lever for this query; the search RPCs and the rerank step are, plus an unexpectedly slow rate-limit check. UNRESOLVED: generation 0.0 s means either the answer came from a cache/reuse path or the generation Server-Timing metric is not recorded on that path; check src/app/api/answer/route.ts and src/lib/server-timing.ts wiring before trusting the split. One sample only; repeat with 3-5 queries before tuning. Search/rerank is a RAG-protected surface: flag before editing and canary any ordering change. LEDGER NOTE: #GCB0DV already has an unreconciled update queued (PR #3039), so a second update to it would go stale; after that one is reconciled, update #GCB0DV and #231 to point here.
